crop.notes: 'Local Lines' column of unrelated sporting notes. The first paragraph (bond sureties) and the 'Blackey' Edwards paragraph (stakeholder fined over the Goss-Allen fight) concern Allen; the rest (dog fights, kennel club, Clipper, Bogardus) do not.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that the sureties on Tom Allen's forfeited bond had petitioned the Governor of Kentucky to reduce the amount, and that stakeholder 'Blackey' Edwards was fined $150 over the Goss-Allen fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, February 18, 1877, page 6.

facts.fact: Allen's bond was forfeited when he failed to appear to answer the Kentucky prize-fighting charge, and his sureties petitioned the Governor of Kentucky for a reduction of the amount
'Blackey' Edwards, stakeholder in the Goss-Allen fight, was fined $150 and costs in the Criminal Court at Covington, Kentucky, for his part at the ring-side

notes: Edwards fact kept because it is a court outcome of the Goss-Allen fight prosecution; drop if stakeholder detail is considered too minor.
